Comment by mhsatman:

General Comment:
Converting C source code is generally straightforward expect the case it
includes too many goto's. Another issue is to convert pointers but it is
easier. I want to write a small article in practical code solutions blog. I
want to explain converting C source to Java when
1) Code includes pointer, multi-dimensional arrays
2) Spaghetti code that consist of too many goto's.

In psigamma() function, for example, I handled the goto's using a private
static class and seperate void methods. A similar solution is applied in
the bratio() method in random.Utility class.

That was the hard part of converting C source. But the psigamma() function
seems extremely aesthetic except its hybrid nature.

mhsatman.
